topic_of_day.title: Intuit sells Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68B
topic_of_day.summary: Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons in an all-cash deal at a $3.68B enterprise value, about five years after buying it for $12B. Closing is expected in early 2027. A core tool for many SMB and startup marketing teams now has a new owner.
topic_of_day.why_now: Announced Nov 19, 2026 alongside Intuit's quarterly results; the buyer's release, an SEC filing and financial press all published the same day.
topic_of_day.bridge: An acquisition is a change event. 'Uses Mailchimp' just went from a fixed field on a list to a live signal, and the list you pulled last week doesn't know it. That is the gap Heloe's signals (deals and business changes, verified at the moment of search) are built for.
topic_of_day.editor_notes: Neutral, factual framing. Do not mock the price drop, do not repeat Hacker News cynicism about the buyer, do not mention the Intuit workforce cut, do not speculate about price increases or product changes. The lesson is about timing and list decay, not about either company.
